name: bakery-business-software
description: Full-stack Bakery Business Management application (orders, inventory, recipes, customers, POS, reporting)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n SERVER,CLIENT -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run db:migrate -w server && npm run seed -w server
